title: Street and Park Trees
description: An inventory of trees in Sandy City, Utah. The same tree inventory is published twice by the city, as `Parks/Grounds_and_Forestry` and as `Pub_Works/ParksDeptTrees`, both reporting the same feature count. This mirrors the Parks copy. 7,966 point features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: Address
table:columns.description: Street address of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 99% of 7,966 rows, 170 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Species
table:columns.description: Tree species.

table:columns.name: Other_Spec
table:columns.description: Species written in free text where it is not on the pick list.

table:columns.name: Tree_ID_
table:columns.description: Identifier of the tree in the inventory.

table:columns.name: Caliper
table:columns.description: Trunk diameter, in inches. Arborists measure caliper at a standard height above ground.

table:columns.name: Height
table:columns.description: Tree height, in feet.

table:columns.name: Condition
table:columns.description: Condition assessed at the last inspection.

table:columns.name: Max_PDOP
table:columns.description: Positional dilution of precision at capture. A GPS quality measure where a lower number means a better fix.

table:columns.name: Collection_date
table:columns.description: Date the tree was surveyed in the field.

table:columns.name: Status
table:columns.description: Operational status of the feature. See the measured values below, because the source layer declares no code list. Measured in the published file: Populated on 49% of 7,966 rows, 4 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Comments
table:columns.description: Free-text note entered by city staff. Unstructured and inconsistently populated.

table:columns.name: Photo
table:columns.description: Reference to a field photograph of the tree.

table:columns.name: AssetID
table:columns.description: Identifier of the asset in the city's maintenance management system. Measured in the published file: Populated on 99% of 7,966 rows, 7,899 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Location
table:columns.description: Street address or place description of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 7,966 rows, 153 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Disease_Abiotic
table:columns.description: Non-living stress affecting the tree, such as drought or soil compaction.

table:columns.name: Disease_Biotic
table:columns.description: Living agent affecting the tree, such as an insect or a fungus.

table:columns.name: Disease_Comment
table:columns.description: Note on the tree's health.

table:columns.name: Disease_Date
table:columns.description: Date the health problem was recorded.

table:columns.name: Hazard
table:columns.description: Type of hazard mapped. Empty in all 7,966 rows of the published file.

table:columns.name: Hazard_Date
table:columns.description: Date the tree was recorded as a hazard.

table:columns.name: Pruning_Needs
table:columns.description: Pruning the tree requires.

table:columns.name: Pruning_Date
table:columns.description: Date the tree was last pruned.

table:columns.name: Tree_Value
table:columns.description: Appraised value of the tree, in dollars. Municipal tree inventories carry this to support claims when a tree is damaged.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
